english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for making an audio or video recording, including recording something or making a recording generally.

examples.english: I'll record what you're saying on my phone.
examples.traditional: 我用手機錄低你講嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 sau2 gei1 luk6 dai1 nei5 gong2 ge3 je5
